status: Copy for the public sample demo. Verify controls and feature names against the deployed build.
headline: Where did the extra cost come from?
subhead: Check an invoice price, an extra shift hour, or the cost of a pour. See the source. Leave with one clear next step.
firstStep: Pick the job that’s on your mind.

cards.title: Did that price go up?
cards.body: Compare the same product and pack. See the change per usable unit.

cards.title: Where did the extra hours go?
cards.body: Put the posted schedule beside the actual punches. Start with the time difference.

cards.title: What does that pour cost?
cards.body: Use the bottle cost, bottle size and your standard pour.

cards.title: Who’s taking care of it?
cards.body: Keep one next action, an owner and a due time together.

tenMinuteGoal: Our goal: one useful answer and a clear next step in your first ten minutes.
receiptBody: Open the sample record and check the math. A missing number is a reason to ask, not a reason to guess.
disclosureBody: This demo uses made up records and fixed calculation rules. Live AI, photo reading, account connections and the ChatGPT store release are still being built. A handoff here is a draft. It does not send anyone a message.
offerBody: That’s the live product offer we’re building toward. Extra seats for your managers will be paid. This sample demo does not create a restaurant account.
feedbackPrompt: What would make this useful before your next shift?

socialImage.headline: Food bill up? Shift ran long?
socialImage.subhead: See the numbers. Pick the next step.
socialImage.footer: Try the sample. Made up records.
